title: Identifying WPA band members: conductor, saxes, clarinets, bass
summary: Paul points out the conductor, Son Johnson, the two Eddie Johnsons, bassist Glennie, Howard Davis, Willie Humphrey, Henry Harden, Sidney Montague, Israel Gorman and Sam Lee.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, I'll point out to a fellow. This is Professor Pitchback Two-Row. Oh, yes. Standing up. He's the conductor of the band. The baton on the left. That's right. Uh-huh. And the other fellow sitting here, the first row, this is... This is the one I was telling you about, Son Johnson. Oh, yes. That's the sax. That's the sax, Son Johnson. This is little Eddie Johnson. We call him Yellow Eddie because they had two Eddie Johnson.
I see. One is Big Head, is it?
Yes. And Little Yellow Eddie. Uh-huh. And this fellow...
The bass player?
Yeah, that's Glennie.
Oh, is that Glennie?
That's Glennie. It looks like his cap on.
I wouldn't have recognized him. Yeah, that's the bass player.
Yes. And this fellow is Howard Davis. Oh, yes.
I met him in California.
Oh, you did? Uh-huh. In Clarinet. And this fellow right here, you know who he is, Willie Humphrey. Yeah.
Who's that between Willie and the... This is Henry Harden.
Oh, Henry.
Oh, that's Henry Harden. Right between there.
Right between there. Oh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Next is Willie. Next is John Casimir. Yeah.
Can you see him making my own?
Yeah. Now... Who's this in bed?
Yeah. Oh, that's Montague.

Sidney Montague. Standing there. That's Sidney Montague. And, uh... This fellow looks like, uh, Israel Gorman if I'm... Might be. No, that's not Israel. Israel over here. Here's Israel Gorman. See him right in front. Right here. Right there, yeah. Yeah. Now here's, uh... This fellow, he's away. Mitchell, they call him. He played Clarinet in there, too. He's away now. Now here's, uh, Sam Lee right behind me. I'm in front and Sam trying to peep over.
Yeah, trying to peep through. Two heads, the heads, the heads, the heads. Yeah. Yeah. Wait a minute. We passed one standing up there, Manuel. Who's that? Behind this...
Another bass player, the third over.
No, that fellow.
Is that light shining right in your eye? Can you see all right?
That's... That's... Look like Oscar Henry. Doesn't it look like him? Maybe. Yeah, I think it is him if I'm not mistaken. This fellow, I can't remember to call him right now. Don't wrinkle up your...
Yeah, but that's all right.
